verdict: No blocking regression found in reviewed code or isolated tests; physical network/background portability remains unverified.

checks.name: Opaque encrypted s/n are bounded data arguments
checks.evidence: Only nonempty <=4096 UTF-16-character inputs without ASCII controls enter the existing argument-only decoder. They are not interpolated into executable source.

checks.name: Decoded output and URL trust stay strict
checks.evidence: applyP1Decoded still rejects unchanged n, exception markers, unexpected fields, invalid output alphabets/lengths. mediaUrl enforces HTTPS googlevideo /videoplayback without credentials/port/fragment/duplicates.

checks.name: P1 fallback eligibility/order unchanged
checks.evidence: VISIONOS first; only typed format/unavailable invoke P1; response/restricted/network/timeout preserve existing paths. A P1 failure preserves original category.

checks.name: Identity/originality/DRM checks retained
checks.evidence: Exact requested video ID, public OK response and AAC only; parsePlayer enforces original audio, DRC/secondary rejection. Non-AAC metadata preserved to prevent implicit originality bypass.

checks.name: Abort and resource bounds retained
checks.evidence: Checked before/after lazy load, request, metadata probe. Request/worker/probe deadlines remain bounded; cancellation removes frame/worker/blob/listeners and ignores late results.

checks.name: Media URLs stay RAM only and refresh invalidates old URL
checks.evidence: stream map only; failed refresh cannot reuse old URL; module reload cannot retrieve previous media locator.

checks.name: Public anonymous recipe build-only provenance
checks.evidence: Explicit Node preparation gets one neutral public embed and public base.js without account/cookie jar/API key/media; runtime consumes a static module and phones contact provider directly.

checks.name: P1 download stays disabled
checks.evidence: Playable source youtube-p1 marks download.allowed:false; download source permission gate rejects before transfer. Music and podcast identities remain unchanged.

limits: Static anonymous provider state can expire or vary by IP/cohort. No guaranteed validity follows from native local cache TTL.
Public opaque client values are not interpreted as account credentials; their complete semantics are not known. Only public unauthenticated acquisition and absence of account fields are established.
Metadata availability does not establish complete audio playback, background playback, every song, or physical Android/iOS compatibility.
P1 reuses the resolver-selected video ID; identity checks do not constitute a new acoustic proof that the selected video matches a catalog master.

The earlier6efab activation failure remains preserved; two unchanged-Chrome controls passed then, and this new build passes one normal control. No production fix for an exact activation cause is claimed.
